verificationSummary: Editor commit e1a2a9dc2d5b2a1557aa8838dc03aecece26d102 adds bounded Structure panel large-document navigation safeguards. OutlinePanel now derives hierarchy facts for the flat Editor Outline order, shows collapse/expand controls for rows with descendants, emits collapsed hidden-count summaries, keeps ancestors forced open when a selected descendant is active, auto-scrolls the selected row into view on selection changes, and windows large visible Structure lists around the selected item. Large-list markup now exposes data-outline-windowed, data-outline-window-selected-index, data-outline-rendered-item-count, and before/after data-outline-window-gap markers so tests and evidence can see when the panel is bounded instead of rendering every row. The hierarchy fact derivation was changed from per-row forward descendant scans to a reverse stack walk, and outlineScannability now guards against the old cursor = index + 1 pattern returning. The retained live Backend browser smoke records initialStructureNavigation and mutatedStructureNavigation; for the active small local document it proves itemCount/renderedItemCount 7 before mutation and 9 after mutation, windowed false, toggleCount 2, hiddenMarkerCount 0, forcedOpenCount 0, and structureNavigationRetainsSmallLiveDocumentRows true. RED evidence included npx vitest run src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts --reporter verbose failing 3 tests for missing data-outline-windowed, data-outline-toggle-target, and data-outline-forced-open; npx vitest run src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts --reporter verbose failing before initialStructureNavigation existed; npx vitest run src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts --reporter verbose failing the source guard while cursor = index + 1 was present; and npx vitest run tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts --reporter verbose failing before this Project Control phase/evidence was registered. GREEN evidence passed npx vitest run src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts --reporter verbose with 8 tests, npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke in the Editor worktree, npx vitest run src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts --reporter verbose with 2 files and 9 tests after fixture update, npm run check in the Editor worktree with 102 test files, 367 tests, and build, and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke in the Editor worktree. Merged Editor main then passed npm run check with 102 test files, 367 tests, and build, followed by FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke with final Outline order editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > summary-left-text > summary-right-text > detail-table > detail-cell-a-text > detail-cell-b-text. Project Control GREEN evidence passed npx vitest run tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts --reporter verbose with 1 file and 2 tests after records were added, then npm run generate and npm run check in the Project Control worktree passed check:data, type-check, 59 test files, 330 tests, build, and 6 e2e tests; merged Project Control main passed npm run check with the same 59 test files, 330 tests, build, and 6 e2e tests. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, direct click-to-type authoring, exact table cell editing UI, exact column layout editing UI, arbitrary rich-inline authoring beyond existing bounded textarea lanes, field-ref chip editing, generic table/toc/page-break add paths, document v4 insert semantics, durable draft persistence, collaboration, full large-document authoring performance readiness, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, export parity, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
